summary: Avoid legacy bootstrap mutations on a clean synchronized governed base

delivery.outcome: Publish a mutation-free no-change result for bare goal -a in adopted legacy targets whose clean default branch equals the authoritative remote HEAD.
nonGoals: No changes to Koru configuration or staged user data
No implicit release or change of delivery mode

architecture.decision: Run the existing managed preflight first, then verify clean Git state and authoritative remote default HEAD before any legacy bootstrap; preserve explicit version, ticket and forced publication flows.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded preflight change; existing late test/commit gates remain.

validation.evidence: Focused regression suite, full Python tests, managed gate and Docker validation
